## What changes and why

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. State skipped platforms/tests and any unresolved failure. For UI changes, include sanitized screenshots and viewport/theme details.

## Review notes

- [ ] No real credentials, kubeconfig, dumps, binaries or private environment data are committed.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate tests or a concrete manual verification.
- [ ] UI changes regenerate the static preview with `scripts/build_preview.py`.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied assets preserve their licenses and notices.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented behavior from planned features.
